correctness.rationale: The induced coordinatewise order on injective ordered triples is used, not geometric-circle configurations. Every mixed comparable triple has e=1 or2 incidences and belongs to L1,U1,L2,U2. In sequence L1 down, U1 up, L2 up, U2 down, the strict witness is unique after predecessor/successor classes have been removed, and each deleted class is an antichain. In surviving A_n, lower/upper triples have at least two incomparable strict opposite-rank neighbors (cyclic boundary edges for n>=4, two distinct all-upper raises for n=3); each mixed incomparable triple has two distinct incomparable predecessors and successors. Thus no beats remain. Counts |L1|=|U1|=12n(n-2), |L2|=|U2|=6n imply |A_n|=2n(2n-4)(2n-5). Independent direct reconstruction n=3..6 tested every stated witness and no-beat residue; n=2 direct 24-triple enumeration gives two 12-cycles and no beats. The n>=3 proof is symbolic, not extrapolated from the tests.
